'''Davik's agent''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] member of the [[Exchange]]. He collected [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from those who either owed or just simply paid [[Davik Kang]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and long-time member of the Exchange. He worked as Kang's agent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. He helped ensure that the [[Lower City]] gangs such as the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]] didn't skip their payments to [[Davik Kang|Davik]] and the [[Exchange]].
